text: 1st experience, staff on the shop floor too busy chatting and on there mobile phones, waited 15mins for my food and when I recieved it, all of it was cold and one meal missing. Resent the whole order back to bring it back hot, 2nd experience, again staff on shop floor too busy chatting and on there phones, I emphasised to the manager, I am on my way to the airport if you they can slightly make it quicker, same again, no care in the world and staff just baffled as to which order they are dealing with. So I had to put my foot down and tell them it's been 10-12mins for my order and its still not ready yet, and all of them started running around like a headless chicken as they didn't have a clue as to what was ready and wasn't ready. Finally after 15mins managed to get my order ready, as I was walking put the staff on the shop floor was having giggles with each other, 3 of them just laughing away like there's no work to do, this was the same case on the first experience aswell. I would sack the lot of them and re-staff the whole team who is keen to move the business with great success
author: Lukman Pepi

text:
The worst branch I have ever tried. We encountered significant issues with the self-service kiosk, leading to confusion and overpayment.

When we approached a staff member, presented our credit card payment records, and requested clarification on whether the kiosk had successfully charged us, his response was highly unprofessional. He laughed off our concerns and even demanded that I switch my banking app to Arabic, claiming he could not understand English, and bizarrely suggested we communicate in Chinese—despite clearly not speaking the language himself.

After we repeatedly explained our concerns using a translation tool, another staff member was called over, who firmly assured us that no charge had been deducted from the credit card via the kiosk. However, upon the completion of our trip and after the transactions posted, I discovered that my credit card had been charged twice—once for the kiosk attempt and once for the counter order.
author: Cassidy Wong

text:
More than 30 minutes' wait for a simple double burger with a coffee; the burger itself turned out to have been sitting in front of me as I was waving my receipt number around at the staff trying to guess what had happened to my order.
As the burger then needed reheating (kitchen / cooking area is not visible from the queue the way I'm used to seeing in most McD's in most countries) I wouldn't be surprised to discover that someone spat in my burger (I was not / am not the obnoxious kind so couldn't be said to have asked for it) as (after not catching a cold for literally years) I am now seeing the main symptoms of a cold precisely 7-8 days later (the typical incubation period of a cold from infection to symptomatic)
author: Mark Benjamin

text:
What a disaster. 40 minutes standing waiting for my collection order of just 3 items. Best analogy is with Cairo roads. No system, whoever flashes their order at the counter and shouts loudest get theirs first.

Completely disorganised staff. Bunch of headless chickens. Grey shirts who I assume are team leaders - useless. What on earth is going on here? Visited twice and same chaos on both occasions. This seems to be the norm for them.

Disgrace of a McDonalds. This branch should be closed down by McDonalds Worldwide HQ. What a joke to be carrying their name through the mud here in the centre of Cairo.

Should be ZERO stars.
author: KB Kent

text: Horribly slow. The biggest fast food franchise and it took them 30 minutes to get out food done. The guy before us was livid because he had been waiting for 50 minutes for his food. Meanwhile, all 5 employees were either pacing doing nothing or inventorying, only checking on our ticket every few minutes and going back to random tasks: refilling the ketchup packet container, the salt dispenser for the fries (while the fries remained frozen in a bag on top of the counter), or restarting the Card systems when no one was using them... Completely ineffective all around.

I would definately say this must be the worst Mcdonalds' experience, I have had since I have been travelling around the world.
